answer.submission_route: Get the appeal form at resolutions.humana.com, then mail it to the Grievances and Appeals PO box (expedited requests use P.O. Box 14165). Confirm on your denial letter. Online: resolutions.humana.com/grievances-appeals-forms By phone: Expedited: 1-800-867-6601, or the number on your card Deadline: Confirm the window on your denial letter -- but your denial letter is authoritative. Use the appeal address printed on your denial letter.
answer.how_to_obtain_criteria: Humana's criteria ARE public but they don't give any policy a permanent web address - links expire within hours. Open the search page and click the title for your surgery ('Knee Arthroplasty - Medicare Advantage', 'Knee Arthroscopy - Medicare Advantage', 'Shoulder Arthroscopy - Medicare Advantage'; change docbegin=H for hip, =S for shoulder). Save the PDF as soon as it opens.
answer.notes: no public criteria on file; abstained and routed
